# Fixed Teeth Solutions

> The UK's full arch dental implant specialists. Fixed, natural-looking teeth —
> often in a day — for people with missing, loose, or failing teeth or dentures.
> Free consultation + 3D scan across 5 clinics in Kent & London. Finance available.

## Treatments
- All-on-4 dental implants
- Full mouth dental implants
- Dental implants
- Smile in a day
- Denture alternatives
- Dental implants abroad
- Periodontal disease treatment

## Key facts
- Full arch implants from £7,997 per arch; finance from ~£176/month (subject to status).
- Clinics: Ashford (Kent), Rochester (Medway), Bexleyheath (SE London), Barnet (N London), Warwick Lodge (Herne Bay).
- GDC-registered clinicians; CQC-regulated clinics; own dental laboratory.
- Free consultation and 3D scan; callback within 60 minutes (8am–8pm).
